# Haps Club

> Haps Club is a hand-picked guide to what is worth doing in Los Angeles this week — events, food, and culture. It is delivered as a free weekly email every Tuesday morning and as a continuously updated homepage at https://haps.club.

Haps Club is independent and editorial: a real person reading the city, not an algorithmic listings feed. Every pick names its LA neighborhood and links straight to the source. Coverage spans the Eastside, Westside, Hollywood, West Hollywood, Mid-City, Downtown, and beyond. Founded and written by Michael Abraham.

## Key pages
- [This week in LA](https://haps.club/): The current week's hand-picked events, food, and culture, filterable by category and neighborhood.
- [Subscribe](https://haps.club/subscribe): Join the free newsletter — one email every Tuesday morning, unsubscribe anytime.
- [About](https://haps.club/about): Who runs Haps Club, the editorial philosophy, and how to submit a tip.
- [Guides](https://haps.club/guides/): Evergreen guides to LA neighbourhoods and to what is free, kept current weekly.
- [Sitemap](https://haps.club/sitemap): A full, human-readable index of pages.

## Guides

Evergreen, hand-written guides to Los Angeles neighbourhoods and to what is genuinely free.
Each one is refreshed every Sunday night with the current week's events, from the same
curated list that runs on the homepage. Every venue named is checked against its own website.

- [Things to Do in Venice, CA](https://haps.club/guides/venice/): One day on foot west of Lincoln — Gjusta, the Venice canals, Abbot Kinney top to bottom, and four dinners ordered by how hard they are to get into.
- [Free Things to Do in Santa Monica](https://haps.club/guides/santa-monica/): The Adelaide stairs, the Wednesday farmers market on Arizona Ave, and the Annenberg Community Beach House — plus the handful of rooms worth paying for.
- [Things to Do in Culver City](https://haps.club/guides/culver-city/): Downtown and the Culver Steps, Ivy Station, and the Helms design district — three walkable pieces about ten minutes apart.
- [Free Museum Days in Los Angeles](https://haps.club/guides/free-museum-days-los-angeles/): Which LA museums are free every day, which are free on set days, and which "free" days still require a timed reservation. Re-checked at the start of every month against each museum's own website, not against other lists.
- [Free Things to Do in LA This Weekend](https://haps.club/guides/free-things-to-do-in-la-this-weekend/): A short, checked list of what is free this weekend, rebuilt every Sunday night, plus everything in LA that is free every weekend of the year.
- [Halloween Events in Los Angeles 2026](https://haps.club/guides/halloween-events-los-angeles/): Pumpkin nights (Descanso Gardens' Carved, Magic of the Jack O'Lanterns, Mr. Bones), Cinespia cemetery screenings, Halloween Horror Nights and Delusion, the free West Hollywood Carnaval, and Día de los Muertos at Hollywood Forever, Grand Park and Olvera Street, with 2026 dates checked on each official site.
- [Supper Clubs and Chef's Tables in LA](https://haps.club/guides/supper-clubs-los-angeles/): Long-table dinners (Haps Club at Hermanito, LA Foodshop, Twentieth Street Garden), matched dinners with strangers (Timeleft, 222), and counter omakase (Shunji, Mori Nozomi, Ueki, Loreto, Hayato), with how each one books.
- [Where to Take Someone Who Says They Don't Like LA](https://haps.club/guides/la-for-skeptics/): Ten Westside-first stops, from the Getty and the Venice canals to a Malibu farm stand, the Hollywood Bowl and Griffith Observatory, with timing and parking tips.

## Events
- [Summer Solstice in the Garden](https://haps.club/events/summer-solstice-in-the-garden/): Saturday, June 20, 2026, 5–9 PM at Twentieth Street Garden in West Adams, Los Angeles. An open-air evening with BBQ on site and a beverage included. Tickets from $10.

## Newsletter archive
- [Open Streets, Late Art](https://haps.club/archive/2026-10-06-open-streets-late-art/): CicLAvia opens downtown streets Sunday, ArtNight lights up Pasadena Friday, and the Westside gets a free late night at the Hammer.
- [Back for Seconds](https://haps.club/archive/2026-09-29-back-for-seconds/): Back to Hermanito Broadway for dinner Thursday, the Lucas Museum is finally open, and the Westside is loaded this weekend with Pier Play and First Friday.
- [Dinner at Hermanito](https://haps.club/archive/2026-09-24-dinner-at-hermanito/): An intimate dinner at Hermanito Broadway, Thursday October 1. Early bird pricing won't last.
- [Let's All Hang Out](https://haps.club/archive/2026-09-21-lets-all-hang-out/): The Summer Social is Wednesday in Santa Monica, there is a free Toastmasters session next Tuesday, and the next BizColab cohort has two seats open.
- [Four Seats Left](https://haps.club/archive/2026-09-15-four-seats-left/): Four seats are left at Saturday's long table, Sophocles runs in Nahuatl at the Getty Villa, and Saturday night makes you choose between a brass band and a rooftop Truman Show.
- [Tap Dance on Pointe](https://haps.club/archive/2026-09-08-tap-dance-on-pointe/): The LA Phil and LA Ballet share a stage for the first time tonight, plus a Thursday triple-header and a new bodega in Venice.
- [The Long Weekend](https://haps.club/archive/2026-09-01-long-weekend/): Labor Day gives us one last three-day run at summer — John Williams at the Bowl, movies at Hollywood Forever, and a new raw bar by the pier.
- [Tonight at Sunset](https://haps.club/archive/2026-08-21-tonight-at-sunset/): Join us this evening, oceanfront in Santa Monica. Dollar tacos tomorrow.
- [Summer Time Fun All Week](https://haps.club/archive/2026-08-18-summer-time-fun/): Our sunset happy hour, free desks by the beach, the Foo Fighters with the LA Phil, and BizColab's second cohort.

## Notes
- Coverage area: Los Angeles, California, USA.
- Cadence: a weekly email on Tuesdays, plus a daily homepage refresh.
- Cost: free.
- Guides are updated weekly from the same curated event data as the homepage.
- Every venue named in a guide has appeared in a Haps Club newsletter issue; nothing is aggregated or scraped.
